import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder
import xgboost as xgb
import os

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Identify target and id
target = "target"
id_col = "id"

# Separate features
train_X = train_df.drop(columns=[target, id_col])
train_y = train_df[target]
test_X = test_df.drop(columns=[id_col])
test_ids = test_df[id_col]

# Encode f_27 using hash encoding (for high cardinality)
train_X["f_27_hash"] = train_X["f_27"].apply(lambda x: hash(x) % 10000)
test_X["f_27_hash"] = test_X["f_27"].apply(lambda x: hash(x) % 10000)

# Encode categorical features f_29 and f_30
le_29 = LabelEncoder()
train_X["f_29"] = le_29.fit_transform(train_X["f_29"])
test_X["f_29"] = le_29.transform(test_X["f_29"])

le_30 = LabelEncoder()
train_X["f_30"] = le_30.fit_transform(train_X["f_30"])
test_X["f_30"] = le_30.transform(test_X["f_30"])

# Create feature interactions
train_X["f_00_f_01"] = train_X["f_00"] * train_X["f_01"]
train_X["f_19_f_20"] = train_X["f_19"] * train_X["f_20"]
test_X["f_00_f_01"] = test_X["f_00"] * test_X["f_01"]
test_X["f_19_f_20"] = test_X["f_19"] * test_X["f_20"]

# Split into train and validation
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_X, train_y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=train_y
)

# Train XGBoost model
model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="auc",
    use_label_encoder=False,
    verbosity=0,
)

model.fit(
    X_train, y_train, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], early_stopping_rounds=50, verbose=False
)

# Get predictions on validation set
val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# Calculate AUC-ROC
auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_score:.6f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
test_pred = model.predict_proba(test_X)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({id_col: test_ids, target: test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
